newsitem.title: UK: Bradford wool market finds some new business.
newsitem.headline: Bradford wool market finds some new business.

text.p: Strongly rising values in Australia for fine merino wool should have pleased the trade in Europes but the pace of the advance caused some anxiety as higher prices are difficult to pass on.
Currency movements magnified the impact for processors and manufacturers in continental Europe while a strong pound sterling eased the blow in the UK.
On the other hand, UK exporters from wool to clothing find their pricing less and less competitive.
A blockade of French ports by fishermen caused some transport problems for UK and French firms but this seems to have been shortlived.

New business was coming through with the Australian price rise although buyers were wary. Deliveries of tops are going out well and combing machinery is under pressure. A dull and depressed New Zealand market contrasted with finer merinos in Australia.
